t: Google's AI Moat, Articulate Apes, and the Higher Leverage of Disruption
s: Google's AI moat stems from its vertical integration (TPUs, Chrome data) enabling price dumping and commoditization of intelligence, posing a threat to competitors. The article advocates for individuals, 'Articulate Apes,' to use high-leverage tools like Python and AI to navigate this disruption and regain agency.
